hookups.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/lake-norman-state-park/camping ('Sites 34 to 44 are paved ... These sites have hookups for electric (30- and 50-amp service available), water, and sewer.') + ReserveAmerica site list ('Campsite Electric': 'Electric Hookup available: 50 amp', 'Full Hookup available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: All paved back-ins. ncparks.gov: sites 1-32 no hookups (with 15x12-ft tent pads), 34-44 full hookups; the booking site types 032 as electric and 033 as non-electric (12 electric in all). Listed driveways on the non-electric sites 40-71 ft (most 51-70); the hookup sites list no length.

sites.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/lake-norman-state-park/camping ('There are 44 campsites'; 'Sites 1 to 32 are paved'; 'Sites 34 to 44 are paved') + ReserveAmerica site list driveway column ('40 Back-In' ... '71 Back-In'; 'Back-In' on 034-044), read 2026-10-22

facilities.source: https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/lake-norman-state-park/camping ('a bathhouse with toilets and hot showers available. There are three potable water spigots ... A dump station is also provided'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Booking page: campsites 'can be made for today and can be made up to 6 Month(s) in advance.' Holiday weekends (Memorial Day, July 4th, Labor Day) need 2 nights, cut to 1 night when booking within 14 days of arrival. Campers with reservations reach their site 24 hours a day by the St. Johns Rd access. Check-in 3 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://northcarolinastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lake-norman-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NC&parkId=552853 (Booking Window; 'Business rules for Holiday Weekends'; 'AFTER HOURS CAMPING ACCESS') + https://www.ncparks.gov/state-parks/lake-norman-state-park/camping (check-in/out), read 2026-10-22

note: Campground near the tip of the peninsula between Lake Norman and Hicks Creek, with six camper cabins. After the day-use gate closes, campers come in by the St. Johns Rd access (from E Monbo Rd, Troutman). --Claude
summary: Confirmed 44 sites, 50-amp full hookups at the hookup sites, dump station, ReserveAmerica booking. Added all back-in with listed driveways to 71 ft, showers, drinking water, year-round, 6-month window with same-day booking, holiday 2-night minimum waived within 14 days, after-hours access road. Fees ($30 non-electric / $45 full hookup incl. $3/night reservation fee; RA $27/$42 for 2026) stand. Not stated: walk-ups, max stay. Booking site types site 032 electric where ncparks.gov says 34-44 (noted).
